formulas.name: RecommendedPriorityFormula
formulas.expression: IF(OR({!Urgency} = "Critical", {!CustomerImpact} = "Business Critical"), "Critical", IF(OR({!Urgency} = "High", AND({!CustomerImpact} = "Multiple Users", {!ServiceType} = "Existing Service Issue")), "High", IF(OR({!Urgency} = "Medium", {!IsNewCustomer} = "Yes"), "Medium", "Low")))
